item.title: DHS buys warehouse in Salt Lake City near airport for $145 million
item.description: After rumors that the Department of Homeland Security was looking to buy a warehouse in Salt Lake City, the agency has bought a property near the airport for over $145 million.

item.title: Vegetation fire in north Springville impacts traffic on I-15
item.description: A field fire broke out in North Springville is sending smoke billowing up over I-15, impacting drivers.

item.title: Colorado man accused of attempting to meet 13-year-old for sex in Utah
item.description: A Colorado man is behind bars after allegedly attempting to meet with and sexually abuse a minor while in town for a wedding. Instead, he met with an undercover detective.

item.title: State care facility employee charged with sexually assaulting disabled resident
item.description: A Pleasant Grove man has been charged with sexually assaulting a disabled resident while he was working as a direct support professional at the Utah State Developmental Center.

item.title: Utah's Jewish community leaders respond after synagogue targeted in Michigan attack
item.description: After an armed attacker rammed his vehicle into a reform synagogue in Michigan, Utah's Jewish community leaders are responding, saying that these types of attacks have become too common.

item.title: Lehi man arrested, charged after allegedly enticing a police officer posing as a 16-year-old girl
item.description: A Lehi man has been arrested and charged after he allegedly enticed a police officer who was posing as a 16-year-old girl.

item.title: Clearfield police cars struck by passing vehicles while stopped with emergency lights on
item.description: A Clearfield police car was hit by passing drivers while it was stopped with its emergency lights on.

item.title: 'He saved his own life': St. George Police talk safety tips after road worker was hit by impaired driver
item.description: The St. George Police Department is encouraging construction zone safety after a worker was hit by a driver who was reportedly under the influence.

item.title: Cedar Valley uses recharge basins to return water to the aquifer
item.description: Cedar Valley Water Conservancy District is currently in the process of using recharge basins to put water back into their aquifer. Here's what that means.

item.title: Woman says car with 58 bundles of meth was gift from boyfriend
item.description: A woman who says she was on a shopping trip in a car her boyfriend recently bought for her is having to explain why 58 bundles of illicit drugs were hidden in the vehicle.
